name: bpmn-studio
description: BPMN Studio: BPMN web modeler (bpmn.io) with an AI assistant (OpenAI, Claude API, OpenRouter, custom OpenAI-compatible, or local Claude Code). Runs entirely in the browser.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-lint-rules.mjs && node web/legacy/build.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web/legacy install --ignore-scripts && npm run build
